nom: La Roche-Posay Retinol B3 Face Serum for Fine Lines & Wrinkles

avis.texte: Love how it makes my skin glow Great addition to my bedtime routine and wake up with a healthy glow
absolutely amazing for beginners and people with sensitive skin. Leaves your skin feeling so smooth and glossy, it's the perfect step before using your gua sha tools in my nighttime routine.
The dropper doesn't work so I had to tilt the bottle to get the product. It smells terrible and feels terrible.

Left my skin irritated and dry. Made my entire face red. Put it on at night woke up with my fae swollen with bumps and irritation. Had to immediately wash my face and let it air dry. Had to take an allergy pill.
I just started using retinol in my routine and this was a great starter! Doesn't cause any breakouts, redness, dryness, or irritation when used correctly. Fast results as well!

This is my first time trying a retinol serum and I am very happy. I have fought oily skin for 40 years. This product kept my face clear all night and looked great in the morning. Definitely part of my skin routine now.
I have sensitive skin. This is the only retinol that I can use. I love everything by LaRoche!
I love this retinol. It doesn't dry my skin out and works well with a little LP cream on top.

I am a skincare fanatic, and have tried all types of skincare from luxury to drugstore for my age/sun spots. I do not have sensitive akin, and I'm 40 with very good skin, but i have some age spots. Within days of use, i'm noticing the couple spots i have diminish. I think with continual uae, they'll be gone. I will defintely be adding this to my regimen. La Roche Posay does it well again!
I like the way this makes my face and neck feel from the very first use. The smell is very light and subtle.

I use twice daily and noticed immediate improvement. Plus, my dermatologist recommends! I'm sure there are many other benefits, but I mostly count on it to reduce wrinkles and age spots. I believe it works very well, and will continue using this product.
I love this serum! It's gentle on my skin but still delivers visible results — smoother texture, less dullness, and no irritation. Perfect for beginners or anyone with sensitive skin.
I have been using Obagi for years and decided to try this. I see a noticeable difference and it has only been about 3 weeks. I think I am going to stay on this and some other La Roche Posay products!

avis.titre: This product is a wonder!!! Love it!!!
avis.texte: I love the way it feels on my skin. It makes my face very soft and it's not greasy. This is a wonderful brand and I will use it again and again.

avis.titre: Applies so nicely…. Until the Retinol burn starts
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product. I felt SO soft when applying it to the skin… then after about a week my cheeks started burning!!! My cheeks became red and it STUNG SO BAD anytime I tried to put anything on my face. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and an knkwn to get contact dermatitis or heat rashes relatively easily, but I've never had a bad reaction to a skin care product before… this was shockingly painful!!! I feel like there shoukd be a warning or better instructions for safe use.

Just starting using it and see a lot of improvement in my skin

After using this product for almost 4 months, 3-4 times a week, I can say I do not see many differences in my skin. The texture and lines of my face and neck have not changed much. I am 28 and this is my first time using retinol again after a 2-3 year break. The last retinol I used worked amazing but they changed the formulation of it. I think I will probably try a new one after this one runs out to see if there is a change.

avis.titre: Doesn't seem to be doing anything
avis.texte: I've been using it for maybe a month or more and i don't notice anything.
With consistent application it makes my face feel so soft and clear. I dilute it with a soft moisturizer after since retinol tends to be harsh, but absolutely works wonders !
If is your first time trying Retinol this is the best, your skin is gonna love it 😍
I haven't seen much of a difference yet. I've been using 3 weeks.

It's OK haven't used it that long and I've oily skin and it doesn't make me feel oily and it doesn't seem to break me out, but I also haven't seen a change in my skin so I'll have to use it more frequently before to see change or decide if I like it more

Every time I use this product my face has various blemishes in the morning. I started slowly, using once every three nights and worked up to nightly and no matter what I'm guaranteed a morning breakout. Is this normal after using this product for over a month?
I had used the product for three days, and then some areas on my skin turned red, and I could feel the burn on it. The skincare routine suggested after using a skin scan test is not reliable
My forehead wrinkles are disappearing and skin is turning over a new leaf!
Good product, my skin is starting to feel smoother. But, I hope when I finish bottle I see more change.
Hi. May i ask, can I apply retinol serum around my ayes and mouth. Thank you
Excellent! Loved it. Will order again soon. I would like to receive a sample of niaceamide to test if I could buy it
Had high hopes for this. Didn't work, broke my face out. returned For reference, I am oily, acne, prone, sensitive

avis.titre: Causing imbalanced skin tone, red dots all over
avis.texte: I started to have red dots eight after I started to use it. I tried to give a few days break and use it in every 2 or 3 days to see if it was really the product causing this problem and I was reassured it was the only reason.

I have mild rosacea and this caused a flare up of skin skin along with red bumps and tiny acne associated with my rosacea. The only thing I changed in my routine is the incorporation of this serum and switched the toleriane moisturizer
So far my face has never been smoother and more radiant. I can see a difference in the appearance as well, only using it a short time!
I use this every day and I can see a difference. I've been asked did I have some work done.
Don't get me wrong, this is a good product. It definitely improved my skins texture. However, it did make my skin very oily during the day so I had to eliminate from my daily routine.

Can u build a fragrance free version of this? And also for other serum? I use serum because moisturizer is too heavy for me. I only want serum to keep my face moisturize. I don't like the smell of fragrance

avis.titre: This is such an awesome serum! I've had lots
avis.texte: Retinol B3 pure retinol serum is such an awesome serum! I recommend!

Unfortunately this product has an extreme fragrance and on top of that, it didn't really FEEL like it was working. I ordered a retinol from another brand and immediately felt the effects. This product is probably loved by many others but it just didn't do the job for me!
I teied loving this product but unfortunately it left my skin extremely irritated and burn.

I really could not believe the visible difference in just a few days. I was amazed. I receive consistent compliments on my skin after using the product for about three weeks. It will now be a staple in my skin care routine!
is never to late to start your anti-aging journey, and this product is a very good to start with before going to a stronger treatment to get your skin used to.

Would be perfect if not for the added fragrance. I don't know why they felt the need to add the fragrance, considering this is recommended by Dermatologists. Otherwise, I like the delivery system and the product itself.

I wanted to love this because I do love some of their other products but this just did not work for my skin. I'm a natural redhead with sensitive, rosacea skin and this is just too sticky and it broke me out.
Fast delivery, so happy with this, it helps the skin texture.

This product has changed my skin! I have finally finished my first bottle and I have noticed my acne has been GONE ever since I started using it. I obviously have a spot here and there but it goes away fast using this product. I'm young so I don't have wrinkles to verify that it does help with that! But it makes my skin bright, bouncy, and it clears it up! I love it so much!!! it is one of the best retinols I have used! And it's on the cheaper side of retinols!
Love it i pair it with the moisturizer and is excellent first i use the retinol wait 5 mins the use moisturizer and wala
Got the worst allergic reaction not sure which of the 3 products purchased through them but I have so many pimples never ever have I had so many. Extremely disappointed
Products seem ok. No irritation but no noticeable different yet. The bottle has very poor design. Fat dropper causing product waste when using.

My girlfriend got retinol burn from using this one. Like really bad, the first day she just red rash but then it became milia. She got in on her neck, chest, whole back m, etc not just her face. We went to urgent clinic and they said the retinol cause the milia on the whole body.

This serum disappointed me, I spent so much money on it and it strained my face. I used this product for three weeks and I got some dark spots on my cheeks and nose that I didn't have before. I used it every other night and in the mornings I raised it well and put sunscreen everyday even the days that I didn't use the serum the night before. I have other products of this brand that work well but this serum did the opposite to me. Now I don't know how to clean these dark spots. I am afraid to use any other product and make it worse.
Fragrance is off putting and dropper it too large for bottle opening, serum inevitably spills down the side of bottle.

It is very gentle, I have not been trying it for a long time and it feels a bit fresh on my skin, it does not irritate me or anything, what I noticed is that without sunscreen it removes more spots, other than that I like the texture, by the way it lasts a short time.
This has reduced my smile lines so much! My only issue is my skin feels a bit dry for a few days after.
I feel this has greatly reduced the appearance of my fine lines. Only problem is it is a bit drying on my skin, but that's going away.

avis.titre: It helped with my pores and sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am in my late 20's. I have a combination skin of oily and dry. I have problems with large pores now, and it's just not cute. I have used this product for the past 8 months, and I love it. I use it for my nightly skin care routine. It helps minimize my pore. The product doesn't irritate my skin at all. Be careful when using and don't mix it with a chemical exfoliant -or- benzoyl peroxide. This will irritate your skin. If you exfoliate one night, then skip using this retinol.
Really nice texture to the serum and I like how my skin feels after wearing it. Would recommend.
Love how this product makes my skin feel! Plus smells amazing!
Its too early to tell a diffrence. It does stings but the sting goes away fast. I will keep using it until I finish it but its too early to say it works.

This product would have more stars if it wasn't for the added scent/perfume. It's very off-putting. Also, the dropper needs redesigning. When you put the dropper back into the bottle all the serum on the outside of the glass tube spills down the side of the bottle because the bottle opening isn't big enough or the dropper tube is too big.

Really love this product, my skin feels soft & looks brighter. The only thing I've wondered if the formula has changed ? My last bottle the contents were a bright yellow, this one I just received is very very light colored almost milky colored.
Hands down La Roche- po say never disappointed hands down the best the lotion are a must have know I have found another gem it's a must try i waking up glowing and refreshed
Consistencia espesa. No irrita la piel. Excelente producto, pude ver y sentir mejoría en la primera semana de uso
Love it, only been using it and I'm seeing improvement in my skin
Love this whole line! Saw a difference with Retinol B3 within 4 days. My granddaughter turned me on to La Roche- Posay, well done!
I'm 82 years old, and for at least 70+ years, I've been abusing my skin with too much sun. I think it's helping my sun damaged skin...but, it hasn't made me look 25 again...LOL

This is the product I was looking for and finally found. I honestly wish I knew it existed sooner, as it would have spared me from all my skin concerns. I recently bought it a week ago and already see positive results on my skin. I have dry, sensitive skin and it immediately exfoliated away the dullness on my skin. In addition, it is stopping my skin from breaking out. The product also didn't irritate my skin. As far as anti-aging goes, it already seems to have smoothed over areas of my skin with fine lines and is healing acne scars. It's well worth the money. I've already recommended the product to others after they noticed an improvement in my skin and wanted to know what I used to get the results. You won't regret buying this product if it gives you the same results as it did for me.
So far so good. I had the purge stage already and acne scars are almost gone

i bought this in france when i ran out of my previous retinol product, my skin is glowing. its never been this great in atleast 3-4 years. ive had it for almost a week now, it's astonishing how quickly it cleared my skin. if you struggle with clogged pores on your forehead—this is for you. its not irratating whatsoever. i totally recommend, doesnt just help with wrinkles but ance!! 10/10
I love how smooth and not oily stays during the day. Perfect for every day use and also very nice glowing finish. Strongly recommend. I will get it again.
I love this I use it everyday and I see results it makes my skin look so radiant and feels good I would definitely recommend this to a friend or family
I like this serum! It's moisturizing and I see results. I love the smell too. It reminds me of walking in a department store and the smell of new shoes and purses lol Best I can describe it!

It is still too soon to say anything about the product other than it is gentle to the skin. However, the bottle it comes in is a hassle. You have to be really, really careful not to spill anything, and a little product still drips when you close it and leaves stains on the counter.

I started using this retinol about 2 weeks again and completely fell in love with it! I LOVE ALL of LaRoche-Posay skincare and would 109% recommend it to others. Especially women with mature skin. The whole skincare line has made my skin nothing but happy! I will continue to use it as long as it's around!

This is my favorite serum! I have used others that were 3-4 x's the price that do not work as well. My skin is not easily irritated, but I wasn't sure if I could tolerate a retinol product this well. I highly recommend to anyone over 50 with combination skin - it keeps my congested areas clear and my skin in smoother and healthy looking.

Was super excited to try this. I have used other products from this brand so I figured there wouldn't be an issue with my skin. Totally broke out everywhere, my face is bumpy and textured in areas I had never seen before. My face had been clear and my acne has luckily subsided for the past few years so it was a little shocking. It was also tacky when applying and I felt like my skin was burning. Unfortunately, I will not continue to use this product. A little disappointed that I had this type of reaction but it happens. Would just be cautious for those who have sensitive skin.

yes, what time is it to enter the world of retinol this is the one for you since its concentration is not so high and it is perfect for beginners it has many benefits including anti-wrinkles it helps you with fine lines and it penetrates your skin making your cells release collagen
It worked great around my eyes and neck. I would highly recommend using this products again. Would like to try samples and I would probably shop for this again.
not only this one, but all the party line products are wonderful my skin looks like a baby I use the entire line and I never miss it in my house. My face appreciates this care

avis.titre: Good quality, does not dry the skin.
avis.texte: This product is very good for dry skin, using every evening will help the skin to become more even. Remove wrinkles. Use sunscreen when going out.
I love the way the product makes my skin feel, it's very gentle.
As I'm aging, fine lines are starting to form. After one use, yes one! I could see the results of smoother, less visual lines on my face..you must try this product!
Glad to say it's not oily and feels like my skin is tighter. I'm going to try it for a couple of weeks and note if there is any change in my appearance.

avis.titre: Saw no difference after months of use.
avis.texte: I used this product until the bottle was no more. I seen no difference with my problem areas and don't recommend. The product felt cheap and didn't like the texture of the product.

I really wanted to love this…it goes on smooth and makes me face feel soft and smooth but I can't get past the horrible fragrance (think grandma's perfume in your face). Tried it twice before bed and ended up getting up and washing it off-smelly!
I look ten years younger thanks to this miracle worker. It is the best retinol I've ever used. It doesn't dry or irritate my skin and leaves it glowing and refreshed!!
I rarely leave home without this! Love at first use! Definitely a must for your collection! Easy to use and affordable. I've recommend this to most of my friends and gotten them hooked as well!
It should not be missing in your routine if you want to avoid wrinkles, it leaves your skin with a glow, its components are the necessary ones for your skin care
My friend has recommended it to me because I am 31 and I have to take care of my skin, the years are catching up with me OMG but I swear my friend has a very beautiful skin

avis.titre: do not use with sensitive skin
avis.texte: This irritated my skin so badly I felt like I had the worst sunburn ever!
Causes itching eyes and conjunctivitis. I use other products from this company with no adverse reaction. I get a similar reaction when I use micellar water.
I have purchased this for the 2nd time. Love this line and products

I'm 28 and wanted to incorporate retinol into my skin care and had read how important it was to go slowly. This was a wonderful product to start with as I experienced no agitation, using it every other day for about a week, and I saw much more firmness in my skin within about a month.
Used Retin A for 30 years and switched to Retinol B3 due to sensitivity of my skin. My skin still looks smooth and bright!

I am a first-time user of Retinol B3 Pure Retinol Serum. It is not drying on my sensitive, combination skin, and I like the smell of it too. I have not used it enough to see any difference in my skin, but I am hopeful and will make a decision to repurchase or not when the bottle is empty.

I love this product I very quickly saw a wonderful shine on my face I look so much healthier my skin is firm. I could see a difference quite quickly follow it up in the morning with a moisturizer that feels like satin on your face highly recommend this

I love this product so far and have been using for a couple of weeks. However, the smell is really strong and gives me a slight headache. I am not sure if I can continue using, which makes me sad bc I want to stick with using this brand.

This retinol is great, I've been using it for almost 3 months and I can see and feel the difference on my skin, I use it 3 times a week and sometimes 5 just at nights, always follow up with a good moisturizer. There are times when I feel that my skin is irritated but I've never seen redness. Keep in mind you MUST wear sunscreen every morning when you're using any retinol, and you are not suppoused to massage retinol into your skin just tap it on.

This product is not for everyone but if you are looking to start using a retinol this is my go to! Start using one day a week until your skin can build up its tolerance. Make sure you are wearing SPF during the day if you are using this product at night!
I have been using it for 3 weeks and It is lightening some spots on my face.

I needed a retinol but was dreading the stinging that normally comes with it. Well not with this one- the hyularonic acid keeps skin moist and soothed while the retinol still does it's work, perfect!!

avis.titre: Good for Mature, Dry Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I tried this because I love La-Roche Posay products. I have used it over a month without any allergic reactions and it has lessened some of my wrinkles. However, the scent/perfume in the product is overwhelming and was, at first, very off-putting. I don't like any fragrance in my face products unless it's subtle so if you're highly sensitive to fragrance this is not the product for you. I was able to get used to the scent over time but I wish they would not have put it in this product.

You are considering starting with retinoids, this is an excellent option since it does not flake and creates tolerance in the skin. It is very gentle plus it contains thermal water to minimize irritation. excellent for mature and young skin

The cheapest and very effective retinol. I also do laser treatments on my face and this retinol works well. I have tested at least 100 retinol creams/lotion/serums and La-Roche makes the best one. It has made my texture smoother and sun spots are gone (I do wear mineral sunscreen). I also wear a hat and always protect my face. It is a little sticky and dries quickly. It does not burn and no redness.

was excited to try this serum out, as someone with eczema and sensitive skin i really wish the denat alcohol and fragrance would be taken out. Without those ingredients this would be a perfect product. Will be returning it sadly :/
Used it for 4 days. Didn't have acne issues before purchasing. After a few days of using I started getting very painful acne on my face. I think that fragrance is too much for my skin.
Started to use this La Roche Posay Retinol B3 Pure and I hope it will prevent future wrinkles :) Texture is good, price is affordable. Let's see!

This product is amazing.. I actually recommend to my mom and you're supposed to use it with a clean and moisturized face.. the moisture the cleaner the better… this product is not for everyone and you're supposed to get used to it by using one day and the next day just rest and don't use it, then use it again and go like that until you feel you're use to it and at this point I use it everyday… my acne scars are gone, just for reference I'm 24, my nose pimples are gone and my face just feel like a baby butt, try to talk to some one or look it up online on how to use this but I know this one would be the most gentle one out there
I have been using this for the last 3 weeks and I have seen a huge difference in my skin texture and brightness. I use it about every 4 days and it is totally worth the price !!
Absorbs quickly, no burning or irritation. I'm not certain I see results yet but I haven't used it long.

I have bought this retinol at least 4 times at this point and absolutely love it! I have super sensitive skin and it does not irritate me at all (which is so rare). I have used prescribed retinols in the past, but they always leave my skin red and dry. Generally, I don't use it everyday, usually every other. I think it has improved my skin texture and evened my skin tone. Definitely worth the money and usually lasts me at least a month!
